asset.name: Morpho

score_rationales.regulatory: DeFi lending, institutional backing signals compliance
score_rationales.supply: MORPHO is capped at 1,000,000,000 tokens with no mint-beyond-max design, and CoinGecko-style figures align with ~606M circulating (~60.6% of total), so a large share is already liquid while the rest follows disclosed vesting rather than uncapped emissions (Morpho governance docs: founder and strategic cohort schedules into 2027–2028). Third-party schedules still imply material unlock cadence over the four-year emission window (~24% in year one cited on tokenomics dashboards), which keeps ongoing sell-side flow risk. Public rich-list snapshots (e.g., CoinLore: top 10 addresses ~74.5% of supply) show extreme on-chain concentration, though Morpho notes many top balances are treasuries, custodians, and contracts—so distribution is not broadly decentralized until more supply sits outside a few labeled wallets. Governance uses holdings for Snapshot votes (wrapped MORPHO for on-chain accounting per docs), not a large yield-staking lock that mechanically removes float.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama’s canonical Morpho TVL is about $7.29B (May 2026), with major liquidity on Ethereum and Base and lending deployed across many additional chains (Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Hyperliquid L1, Monad, Katana, etc.), plus roughly $4B in borrowed-side liquidity—indicating deep, actively used lending markets rather than idle deposits.
